description: Public Transport Enabler is the project's Java library for querying public-transport providers through a shared interface. It contains methods for nearby stops, departure boards, location suggestions and trips between places, with optional accessibility or walking preferences. Inputs are station identifiers, coordinates, dates and query options; outputs are structured Java result objects. Geographic coverage and time availability depend on the selected provider, and departure information may be live. The library is free under GPL-3.0-or-later and requires Java 8 or Android 7 APIs. A limitation is that some providers require their own API keys and may offer different query capabilities. Those external service terms are separate from the library licence. The results can help prepare or compare public-transport routing and service simulations. OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap) supplies related transport geography. No provider credentials were requested and no live transport API was called.
